purpose: Complete the ZemdaPersonal exercise media library so every existing exercise has a GIF.
important_context: The current main already contains 128 media mappings. Preserve them.
The previous validation reviewed 208 candidates and added 68 new mappings; the 140 entries below are the remaining exercises.
Do not stop at candidates previously rejected. Search the complete local ExerciseGymGifsDB repository by movement, equipment, body position and execution described in the Zemda record.
The description/instructions in the Zemda validation file are the primary matching basis; exercise name alone is insufficient.

Every remaining Zemda exercise must receive a GIF. When the source repository has no exact variant, use the closest biomechanical equivalent only after an exhaustive search, and document the approximation.
codex_execution_order: Read backend/src/config/exercise-library.media.json and preserve all existing mappings.
Read docs/exercise-media/exercisegymgifs-validation.json for the exact Zemda description of every remaining ID.
For every remaining entry below, search the entire ../ExerciseGymGifsDB tree, including api/en and api/es metadata and all muscle folders.
Inspect the actual GIF before selecting it. Compare movement pattern, start position, trajectory, equipment, grip, unilateral/bilateral execution and body position.
Re-check previous rejected candidates only if a fresh search does not find a better candidate.
Copy only the selected GIF (and its .thumb.webp when useful) into frontend/public/exercise-media using the Zemda exercise ID.
Update the existing backend/src/config/exercise-library.media.json. Do not create a second media manifest.
Keep current hover/touch/modal GIF behavior and lazy loading.
Run media tests and frontend/backend builds.
Final acceptance condition: all 268 existing Zemda exercises resolve to a valid gif_url and no exercise remains without GIF.
